test_title: PYST 2: SSC CGL Tier - II (English) (Held on: 3 Feb 2022)
subject: english
question: Why could Nabamita Ray not reach the area to see the damage done by the leaking oil?

options.text: The area was barricaded to stop the people to go in as it might be dangerous.
The area was covered with thick slippery oil and it was impossible to walk.
The villagers stopped her from visiting the Maguri jheel.
She was stopped by the forest authorities as she might disturb the animals.

solution:
The correct answer is **"The area was barricaded to stop the people to go in as it might be dangerous."**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__** 

 
• In the **sixth **paragraph of the given comprehension, Nabamita Ray states **"I visited the area on Sunday but it was barricaded. I could see the damage everywhere".**

**Hence, the correct answer is option 1**
